verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents a GraphQL Developer API that supports introspection of its queries and mutations, plus a browser-based playground for testing them against the live tenant, so the product can be driven programmatically. How much of the product the API can drive is unproven: the visible reference covers framework health, vendor data and custom-integration push APIs, access needs an admin-gated API key, and no OpenAPI or downloadable schema exists (probe paths returned 404). missing for 10: evidence of broad API coverage across product workflows, a downloadable machine-readable spec (OpenAPI/schema artifact), non-admin or scoped API access, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Introspection allows the API to describe its schema, including available queries, mutations, and response types.
You can use the playground to explore the API schema, test queries and mutations, and validate responses in real time.
